title: Gateway account separates partial return from full restoration
summary: The existing Gateway Atlas account gains six sections and eight dated entries from five primary HTML records and three scoped PDF texts. Earlier partial-return evidence and the open restoration question retain their original dates.
evidence_note: Commissioning, inventory, cleanup responsibilities, operator correction claims and future contractual delivery retain distinct meanings. Conflicting introductory and detailed owner targets remain visible. No regulator acceptance, current full restoration or new identity is inferred; PDF images and underlying EPA collection records were not inspected.
publication_effect: Local source integration only; production rendering, release and launch remain unverified.
